description: Reads one original supporting file attached to an innovation or invention disclosure, by its attachment id from fetch. By default the result holds the file itself: a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image up to 3.75 MB as an image, text or markdown as text, and a PDF or any other file as an embedded file, up to 10 MB. With format url the result holds a read-only download link, valid for five minutes, and a curl command that saves the file.

attachment_id.description: The attachment id from the innovation or invention disclosure attachment inventory

format.description: content (the default) for the file itself, url for a download link

name: get_attachment
title: Read Lightbringer attachment
